title: Maximum Matrix Sum by Pair Flips
description: In one operation, choose two distinct cells of a matrix and negate both values. You may repeat the operation any number of times. Given a square integer matrix, return the maximum total sum that can be achieved. Input: `matrix`. Output: the maximum sum after choosing the flips.
hints: Check each cell using its row and column relationships.
Handle single-row, single-column, tie, and center-cell cases explicitly.
